items.intent: Trigger an immediate user action.

recipe.use: Trigger an immediate user action. Prefer native button keyboard behavior.
recipe.avoid: Do not simulate disabled semantics with color alone; the adapter gates aria-disabled requests.
recipe.semantics: Native button; focus-visible remains distinct from a momentary tactile press.

items.intent: Toggle an independent boolean choice, with optional indeterminate presentation when the owning application state requires it.

recipe.use: Model independent boolean selection; only show mixed when the application owns an indeterminate state.
recipe.avoid: Do not conflate indeterminate presentation with a third submitted form value.
recipe.semantics: Native checkbox with checkbox adapter synchronizing data-state.

items.intent: Accept a single-line user-entered textual value through a native text-like input control.

recipe.use: Collect a single line of user-authored text with the native input.
recipe.avoid: Inputs are editable, not pressable; do not add button-style compression.
recipe.semantics: Native input remains responsible for selection, caret and IME.
recipe.exampleMarkup: <input class="ns-input" id="input-demo" type="text" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Type without fake press motion" />

items.intent: Select one option within a mutually exclusive choice set while preserving native radio-group semantics.

recipe.use: Choose exactly one option from native radio peers with the same name.
recipe.avoid: Do not force aria-checked manually or model Radio as a toggle button.
recipe.semantics: Native radio group and existing bindRadio group state synchronization.
recipe.exampleMarkup: <input class="ns-radio-input" id="radio-alpha" type="radio" name="radio-demo" value="alpha" checked />

items.intent: Toggle a single binary setting between off and on with immediate state feedback.

recipe.use: Represent an immediate binary setting with native checkbox input and role switch.
recipe.avoid: Never invent a third indeterminate state for Switch.
recipe.semantics: Native checkbox; the real switch adapter owns data-state and role.

items.intent: Organize peer content panels into a keyboard-navigable single-selected tab set without introducing route or business-domain semantics.

recipe.use: Organize closely related panels within one keyboard-navigable composite.
recipe.avoid: Do not toggle aria-selected without letting the Tabs controller change its panel.
recipe.semantics: Real tab click; original roving focus and panel controller remain authoritative.

items.intent: Accept multiline user-entered textual content through a native textarea control while preserving platform editing, selection, scrolling, and resizing semantics.

recipe.use: Collect multiline authored text and preserve line breaks.
recipe.avoid: Do not replace the native textarea with a non-editable card.
recipe.semantics: Native textarea retains resize, scrolling and composition behavior.
recipe.exampleMarkup: <textarea class="ns-textarea" id="textarea-demo" rows="5" placeholder="Write multiple lines without fake press motion"></textarea>

items.intent: Choose one value from a finite option set through a native single-select control.

recipe.use: Choose one value from a small, browser-owned native option list.
recipe.avoid: Do not fake a custom popup or claim the browser option sheet is styled by Core.
recipe.semantics: Native select; change events belong to the browser.
recipe.exampleMarkup: <select class="ns-select" id="select-demo" name="select-demo"><option value="alpha">Alpha option</option><option value="beta">Beta option</option><optgroup label="More options"><option value="gamma">Gamma option</option><option value="disabled" disabled>Unavailable option</option></optgroup></select>

items.intent: Group related informational content on a stable visual surface without implying activation or navigation.
Present compact informational metadata or status without implying activation, navigation, selection, or live-region behavior.

recipe.use: Communicate compact, noninteractive metadata with a visible text label.
recipe.avoid: Tone is not an action, and meaning cannot rely on color alone.
recipe.semantics: Passive span with canonical data-tone styling; no added roles.

items.intent: Present a prominent inline message or callout without implying activation or automatically creating live-region behavior.
Associate one primary form control with its visible label, description/help, requirement context, and validation message without replacing the control's native semantics.
Expose the current location as an ordered hierarchical navigation path with real ancestor links, a non-interactive current page, and presentation-only separators.

Navigate between discrete pages in an ordered collection using real destinations, one explicit current page, and compact tactile navigation items without owning routing, collection loading, or page-size policy.

Choose exactly one active mode or view from a small set of peer button actions while preserving persistent selected state, native button activation, and a clear boundary from form-value radio groups and tab-panel composites.

recipe.use: Select one view mode from a mutually exclusive button group.
recipe.avoid: Do not allow two aria-pressed segments or select the disabled item.
recipe.semantics: bindSegmentedControl enforces exactly one selected segment.

items.intent: Provide concise non-interactive supplemental text for a target on hover or keyboard focus without changing the target's semantics, becoming a popup action surface, or making non-interactive content appear actionable.
Edit a text query while navigating and committing one value from a related suggestion list without importing business-domain filtering semantics.
Disclose and collapse related content sections through explicit button-controlled panels without introducing navigation, tab-panel, or business-domain semantics.

recipe.use: Show or hide disclosure panels using real trigger and panel ID relationships.
recipe.avoid: Never set aria-expanded without the matching panel and single-expansion rules.
recipe.semantics: bindAccordion handles native button activation, aria-expanded and panel.hidden.

items.intent: Provide visible labeling text that is programmatically associated with a labelable control without replacing the control's native semantics.
Group closely related action buttons into one recognizable control cluster without changing each button's native activation semantics.
Compose one primary text-entry control with generic leading or trailing adornments and actions while preserving the primary control as the semantic authority.
Edit a bounded or unbounded numeric value with direct text entry and optional increment/decrement actions while retaining numeric form semantics.

recipe.use: Edit a bounded numeric input with the real increment and decrement buttons.
recipe.avoid: Do not bypass min/max/step or pretend input value is application state.
recipe.semantics: bindNumberField owns validity, input state and step-button availability.
recipe.exampleMarkup: <input class="ns-number-field__input" id="number-field-input" type="number" min="0" max="12" step="1" inputmode="numeric" />

items.intent: Represent one independent pressed or unpressed option whose state persists after activation and is distinct from an immediate-setting Switch.

recipe.use: Maintain an independent persistent pressed state on a semantic button.
recipe.avoid: Momentary :active pressure feedback is not the persistent aria-pressed state.
recipe.semantics: bindToggle owns pressed state after native click.

items.intent: Coordinate a named set of Toggle controls with explicit single- or multiple-selection policy while preserving each item's pressed-state semantics.
Select one scalar value or bounded value range along a continuous or stepped axis using one or two focusable thumbs.

recipe.use: Adjust a numeric scalar via native range input and the existing Slider controller.
recipe.avoid: Do not handwrite a new track or overwrite the output label without dispatching native input.
recipe.semantics: Range input receives events; existing controller maintains the value output.
recipe.exampleMarkup: <input class="ns-slider__input" id="slider-input" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="40" aria-label="Volume" />

items.intent: Expose completion of a task as a determinate value or an explicitly indeterminate progress state without implying user control.
Provide a compact visual busy indicator for an already-labeled loading context without inventing progress percentage or mandatory live-region behavior.
Separate adjacent content or control groups with a semantic or decorative boundary whose orientation is explicit.
Choose zero or more committed values from a finite option set while preserving explicit multi-selection semantics and ordinary document focus traversal.
Accept a fixed-length one-time code as one logical value while supporting paste, autocomplete and segmented presentation without fragmenting form authority.
Select one or more local files through native file-input authority with optional drag-and-drop acquisition and explicit selection or validation state.
Select one opaque color value through a platform color-selection control or accessibility-equivalent picker while exposing an explicit committed value.
Enter or select a calendar date, or a bounded date range mode, while preserving explicit date-value semantics and calendar-backed keyboard access.
Enter or select one local wall-clock time value with optional bounds and step granularity while preserving platform time-input semantics.
Display and navigate a calendar grid for one-date or bounded-range selection with explicit current, selected and unavailable day semantics.
Present an application-modal content surface that temporarily contains focus and interaction until dismissed or completed, without adding alert-confirmation semantics or business-domain policy.
Interrupt the current workflow with a brief important modal message that requires a user response, without embedding business-domain policy or action side effects.

Present supplemental application content and actions in a modal edge-origin overlay with deterministic dismissal and focus restoration, without becoming page navigation, routing, or business-domain authority.

Present explicitly invoked anchored supplemental content in a non-modal top-layer overlay with deterministic light dismissal and safe focus behavior, without becoming modal, menu, navigation, or business-domain authority.

Reveal structured non-interactive supplemental preview content from pointer hover or keyboard focus after a controlled delay, while preserving ordinary document interaction and avoiding Tooltip, Popover, menu, navigation, or business-domain semantics.

Present an explicitly invoked anchored menu of domain-free actions or commands from a menu button with deterministic composite keyboard navigation and dismissal, without becoming generic Popover, ContextMenu, Menubar, NavigationMenu, value-selection, or business-command authority.

Present a context-specific temporary menu of domain-free actions or commands from an explicit keyboard-reachable context target using platform context invocation, deterministic composite keyboard navigation, and safe dismissal without becoming DropdownMenu, generic Popover, Menubar, NavigationMenu, value-selection, or business-command authority.

Present a persistent horizontal application-command menubar with one composite Tab stop, deterministic root-item roving focus, optional first-level menu disclosure, and local command/checkable activation without becoming DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, generic Popover, Toolbar, NavigationMenu, value-selection, searchable CommandMenu, routing, or business-command authority.

Present a named site/application navigation hierarchy with native destination links, optional first-level disclosure controls, current-route semantics, and ordinary document focus traversal without becoming Menubar, DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, generic Popover, Tabs, Breadcrumb, Pagination, Drawer, or routing/history authority.

Present transient queued status announcements without blocking interaction, stealing focus, becoming stable inline Alert content, or acquiring dialog, popover, menu, routing, business, network, or form authority.

Present static or read-only tabular data with native row/column relationships and header associations without acquiring grid, sorting, selection, editing, pagination, filtering, virtualization, or business-data authority.

Navigate, optionally select, and explicitly enter editing within interactive tabular data through one managed grid focus model without acquiring sorting, filtering, pagination, virtualization, hierarchy, persistence, network, or business-data authority.

Present one reusable structured content row or unit with optional leading, primary, supporting, metadata, trailing and action regions without acquiring collection, selection, navigation, activation, disclosure, editing, persistence, network, or business authority.

Present one semantic collection or sequence of related items with native list structure while preserving authored ordering, nested-control behavior, and passive collection semantics without acquiring option selection, composite navigation, disclosure, editing, virtualization, persistence, network, or business authority.

Present authored term-and-description relationships with native description-list semantics while preserving one-to-many and many-to-one term/description groupings, descendant-control behavior, and passive document structure without acquiring collection ordering, selection, composite navigation, disclosure, editing, persistence, network, form, or business authority.
